name: El Monte City Council Notice of Adjournment January 19, 2021
agenda_text:
CITY OF EL MONTE
  CITY COUNCIL
  NOTICE OF ADJOURNED REGULAR CITY COUNCIL MEETING
  AND CONTINUED PUBLIC HEARINGS PURSUANT TO
  GOVERNMENT CODE SECTIONS 54955 AND 54955.1
NOTICE IS HEREBY GIVEN that the El Monte City Council adjourned its Regular City
Council Meeting and continued its agendized public hearings set for Tuesday, January
19, 2021 to an Adjourned Regular City Council meeting on Friday, January 22, 2021 at
5:00 p.m. to take place at 11333 Valley Boulevard, El Monte, CA 91731.

POSTED AT 9:30 a.m. on January 20, 2021 by Griselda Contreras, Chief Deputy City
Clerk/Records Manager
